negativeOrNullFindings: PMID 29397376 (SUSTAIN 7) and PMID 35914543 (SURPASS J-mono) are head-to-head trials in which dulaglutide was the comparator and was outperformed. A dossier that cites only AWARD trials would misrepresent where dulaglutide sits in the current class.
PMID 34984808 examines atrial fibrillation/flutter incidence in REWIND - include rather than only efficacy post hocs.
cautions: REWIND is the CV outcome trial; do not conflate it with the AWARD phase 3 programme.
AWARD trial numbering runs to at least AWARD-11 plus regional variants (AWARD-JPN, AWARD-CHN3, AWARD-PEDS). Do not treat 'AWARD' as one trial.
Estimand discipline: check whether any weight or HbA1c figure quoted is the treatment-regimen estimand from the publication or a sponsor efficacy estimand.
